movie.title: Assault on Precinct 13
movie.overview: A highway patrol officer, two criminals, and a station secretary form an unlikely alliance to defend a defunct Los Angeles precinct against a siege by a bloodthirsty street gang.

facts: You'll love the unusual alliance at the heart of the 1976 film! A highway patrol officer, two criminals, and a station secretary must team up to defend their turf.
The setting is super specific and adds to the tension: it all goes down in a defunct Los Angeles precinct. Talk about being isolated!
And who are they fighting? Not just any bad guys, but a truly bloodthirsty street gang. The stakes couldn't be higher!
